summary:
Research handoff folding the two newly measured consequence scenarios into the behaviors that own them; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Both confirmed findings whose importance rested on an unmeasured consequence now carry measured consequence evidence on the behavior that owns the mechanism. Heartbeat fast path (second scenario f8caf123, execution 7628b537): after an out-of-window heartbeat the receiver adopted the sender as its known leader and rejected an otherwise acceptable vote from a configured candidate, while a node that never saw the heartbeat granted it — so the skipped RPC-header gate suppresses a legitimate election, not merely a guard comparison. TimeoutNow (second scenario 38aa8959, execution ec71e087): a voter that already followed another leader granted a configured candidate's vote when the transfer privilege was set and rejected the identical request without it, and the flag did not defeat the configuration-membership check — so the privilege really does override leader stickiness. Both scenarios completed with matched prerequisites, full comparisons (outcome holds) and correspondence no_issue_found, and both stayed with their existing requirement.

Product contents: the draft map (base version 14) adds one branch note to b-heartbeat-fast-path and one to b-timeout-now, each citing the execution that produced it. No trigger, guard, write, edge, requirement or previously accepted Surface changed, so the four confirmed violations, the two corroborating comparisons and all accepted results keep their original basis. Feedback carries the reference set and the remaining list.

Still open, explicitly: deployment-level reachability premises (an out-of-window peer delivering a pure heartbeat; an unconfigured sender delivering TimeoutNow); the duration of the heartbeat suppression and any quorum-level consequence (no timing, no live cluster); the batching-FSM ConfigurationStore exemption question; the lifetime of a snapshot-installed tail under a live leader; the ReloadConfig notification-scope and processHeartbeat concurrency leads; and the still-unread in-memory snapshot store, observer plumbing, and net_transport beyond the classification and pipeline review.
